name: ClybGuidance (APG family with scale schedule and scalar projection)
plain: A Chroma-oriented APG with many options: uncond scalar projection like CFG-Zero★, a sine-shaped guidance multiplier by time, an atan2-sin mixed uncond, EMA momentum, and a norm cap relative to cond.
math:
Optional uncond ← lerp(uncond, sin(atan c)/cos(atan u), w_a)
Optional α = ⟨c,u⟩/‖u‖² (logsumexp variant); uncond ← α·uncond
GM = lerp(1, sin((1−t^shift)π), ratio); scalar = 1/s + GM·(s−1)/s; g = (c−u)·scalar
Momentum: v ← lerp(v, g, 1−β); g' = g + m·v, with renorm option
g⊥ + η·g∥ (projected on c)
Norm cap: ‖u+g·s‖ ≥ T‖c‖ → g ← g·T‖c‖/‖u+g·s‖
x̂_c' = u + g

props.params: eta, norm_threshold=0, momentum, momentum_beta, momentum_renorm, scalar_projection, scalar_logsumexp, rescale_phi, var_rescale, scale_up_ratio, scale_up_shift, atan2sin_ratio
